provided.title: File:Colorful beaded necklaces at Nairobi City Market in Kenya.jpg

observed.caption: Colorful beaded necklaces and plaid textiles displayed on a market stall.
observed.description: A wooden display board with dark blue backing holds multiple rows of large, circular, multicolored beaded collar necklaces on hooks, with a cluster of black cord necklaces with light-colored pendants hanging in the center and several long, thin, multicolored and light blue beaded strand necklaces hanging vertically on the right side of the board. To the right of the board hang several folded plaid fabrics with fringed ends in blue, green, and red patterns, beside patterned garments with geometric prints in blue, yellow, and red. At the base of the display are framed paintings leaning against the board, one showing an elephant and landscape with green and yellow tones. In the background to the right, a dimly lit market interior with shelves holding footwear and additional goods is visible on a concrete floor.
